three_quarter: Three-quarter camera view. Decide the side and height from source evidence; check background vanishing lines and occlusions.
lateral: Lateral camera view. Change the environment perspective coherently, not only the performer's orientation. Hidden geometry remains uncertain.
wide: Wider camera view with enough margin for the complete observed hand gesture. Preserve object positions; do not invent visible objects to fill the frame.
overhead: True overhead camera looking vertically down. Preserve the source initial head and body pose; do not tilt the head to face the camera.
floor: Low camera near the floor looking up. Determine visibility before describing objects. Objects above or behind the camera may be out of frame.
rear: Camera behind the performer. Face identity and lip motion may be unobservable. Do not invent a different body lean or action.
